# House of Perfection

> Advanced skin and beauty clinic in Randpark Ridge, Johannesburg, South Africa. Established in 2002. Let Go. Relax. Recharge.

- Address: 7 Ateljee Street, Randpark Ridge, 2156, South Africa
- Phone / WhatsApp: 083 641 4426 (+27 83 641 4426)
- Email: Karmen@houseofperfection.co.za
- Trading hours: Tuesday and Thursday 09h00-18h00; Wednesday and Friday 09h00-17h00; Saturday 09h00-15h00
- Every facial includes a complimentary eyebrow wax or tweeze. Gift vouchers are available in store, via email or WhatsApp.

- [Manicures & pedicures](https://houseofperfection.co.za/manicures-pedicures.html): gel and classic, Lola Lee Gel
- [Waxing & tinting](https://houseofperfection.co.za/waxing-tinting.html): ladies only
